control_guidance.description:

the extra comparison forward that drops control-map vision items. Values > 1.0 blend
velocities from with-maps vs without-maps forwards on the generated clip.
control_guidance.title: Control Guidance

control_guidance_interval.description:
Timestep interval [lo, hi] (0–1000) in which control-CFG is applied; None applies
on every step.
control_guidance_interval.title: Control Guidance Interval

show_control_condition.description: If set, include the control condition (hint map) in the saved output.
show_control_condition.title: Show Control Condition

show_input.description: If set, include the input video alongside the generated output.

num_first_chunk_conditional_frames.description: Number of conditioning frames for the first chunk (defaults to ``num_conditional_frames``).

names the active control modality (e.g. "Follow the edge control video precisely.
..."). Set False for clean baselines / ablations. The system prompt is unchanged.
emphasize_control_in_prompt.title: Emphasize Control In Prompt

max_new_tokens.description: Maximum number of new tokens to generate per prompt.
max_new_tokens.title: Max New Tokens

do_sample.description: If True, sample from the logits; otherwise greedy decode.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Ignored when ``do_sample`` is False.

top_k.description: Top-k logit truncation. Ignored when ``do_sample`` is False.
top_k.title: Top K

top_p.description: Nucleus-sampling threshold ``0 < top_p <= 1``. Ignored when ``do_sample`` is False.
top_p.title: Top P

repetition_penalty.description: CTRL/HF-style multiplicative repetition penalty (>0). ``1.0`` is identity.
repetition_penalty.title: Repetition Penalty

presence_penalty.description: Additive presence penalty (any sign). ``0.0`` is identity.
presence_penalty.title: Presence Penalty

video_fps.description: Frames per second to sample from a video vision_path. None -> decoder default (2.0).
video_fps.title: Video Fps

action_path.description: Path to action JSON file. Required for forward_dynamics mode.

raw_action_dim.description: Dimension of the raw action data. Required when action_path is not provided.

enable_sound.description: Enable joint video+sound generation (t2vs mode). Requires a checkpoint with sound modules.
enable_sound.title: Enable Sound

sound_path.description:
Path or URL to a conditioning audio clip (e.g. .wav/.mp3/.flac). Required for
audio_image2video; the clip is encoded by the AVAE and used as a clean condition.
sound_path.title: Sound Path

vision_path.description: Path or URL to conditioning image/video.
vision_path.title: Vision Path

condition_frame_indexes_vision.description: Latent frame indices to condition on. Defaults to [0] for image, [0, 1] for video.
condition_frame_indexes_vision.title: Condition Frame Indexes Vision

condition_video_keep.description:
Whether to take the first or last ``max_frames`` of the conditioning
video when it is longer than needed. Defaults to ``"first"``. No effect
on image conditioning.
condition_video_keep.title: Condition Video Keep

resolution.description:
Vision resolution tier, not a pixel dimension. Resolved against
``aspect_ratio`` by ``vision_size`` -- ``"256"`` at the default ``16,9``
yields 320x192. See docs/inference.md for the full table.

Defaults to model config resolution.

Accepting a value here does not mean the loaded checkpoint can generate it.
Per the published model cards:

* Cosmos3-Edge: 256/480, images and video.
* Cosmos3-Nano: 256/480/720, images and video.
* Cosmos3-Super: 256/480/720; 768 additionally for images (the shipped tier
  of the Super-Text2Image variants).

These ranges are not enforced per checkpoint: a value outside them still
runs, at a tier the model was never trained on.
resolution.title: Resolution

aspect_ratio.description:
Vision aspect ratio. When None, image_edit preserves the input image's native
aspect ratio; all other modes default to 16:9.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

fps.description: Vision frames per second. Recommended range [10, 30]; quality may be degraded outside of this range.
fps.title: Fps

num_frames.description:
Number of vision frames.

Range by resolution: 256p: [24, 400], 480p: [24, 300], 720p/768p: [24, 200].
These are global limits; a checkpoint's own published range may be tighter
(Cosmos3-Edge is documented as 50-150 video frames).
num_frames.title: Num Frames

prompt_path.description: Path to a .txt file containing the prompt. Only one of 'prompt' or 'prompt_path' should be provided.
prompt_path.title: Prompt Path

prompt.description: Text prompt for generation. Only one of 'prompt' or 'prompt_path' should be provided.

inverse_resolution_template.description: Inverse template for resolution metadata in the negative prompt.

sigma_max.description: Maximum sigma for the EDM sampler. Ignored when sampler='unipc'.

seed.description: Seed for the random number generator.

quantization_method.description:
Quantization method (``mxfp8`` / ``nvfp4``), or ``None`` to disable.

Post-training quantization (PTQ) is applied in-place to the model at load
time. Only supported on Blackwell architectures and when FSDP sharding is disabled.
quantization_method.title: Quantization Method

quantization_include_regex.description: Regexes matched against module FQNs; a Linear is quantized only if it matches one (empty = all).
quantization_include_regex.title: Quantization Include Regex

quantization_exclude_regex.description: Regexes matched against module FQNs; a Linear is skipped if it matches any.
quantization_exclude_regex.title: Quantization Exclude Regex

mixed_precision_first_steps.description:
ModelOpt FP8 checkpoints only: run the first N diffusion steps with 16-bit
activations (W8A16) instead of FP8 activations (W8A8). 0 disables.
mixed_precision_first_steps.title: Mixed Precision First Steps

mixed_precision_last_steps.description: ModelOpt FP8 checkpoints only: run the last N diffusion steps with W8A16.
mixed_precision_last_steps.title: Mixed Precision Last Steps

mixed_precision_reasoner_policy.description:
Understanding-pathway precision when mixed precision is enabled:
high_precision keeps reasoner linears on W8A16 for every step.
mixed_precision_reasoner_policy.title: Mixed Precision Reasoner Policy

mixed_precision_w8a16_cache.description:
W8A16 dense-weight source: none (default) dequantizes per call and works
everywhere, including FSDP-sharded runs, at wall time indistinguishable from
the cached modes; generation/all hold resident BF16 caches; gpu_block/
cpu_block stream per-layer double buffers. FSDP-sharded runs support only
none.
mixed_precision_w8a16_cache.title: Mixed Precision W8A16 Cache

device_memory_utilization.description:
Fraction of device memory to use for model weights.

Used for automatic sharding.
device_memory_utilization.title: Device Memory Utilization

compile_dynamic.description:
Compile with symbolic-shape kernels (maps to ``torch.compile(dynamic=...)``).

Defaults to ``True`` for backward compatibility with training, which can
see varying shapes across batches.  Setting to ``False`` produces faster
kernels when the shapes are stable (e.g. single-prompt AR inference), at
the cost of a recompile on shape change.
compile_dynamic.title: Compile Dynamic

use_separate_pipeline_vision_decode_gpu.description: Whether to place pipeline vision decode on a spare local GPU when one is available.
use_separate_pipeline_vision_decode_gpu.title: Use Separate Pipeline Vision Decode Gpu

config_file.description: Hydra config store module, Hydra config yaml file, or Hugging Face model json file.

vlm_processor_from_checkpoint.description: Load the VLM processor from the loaded checkpoint instead of a hardcoded repo.
vlm_processor_from_checkpoint.title: Vlm Processor From Checkpoint

credential_path.description: Path to S3 credentials file for remote checkpoint loading.
credential_path.title: Credential Path

use_ema_weights.description: If True, use EMA weights. Otherwise, use regular weights.
use_ema_weights.title: Use Ema Weights

keep_going.description: If True, catch and log errors instead of raising them.
keep_going.title: Keep Going

skip_invalid_samples.description:
If True, skip samples whose modality (e.g. action, sound) is not supported by the
loaded model and emit a ``status='skip'`` output instead of raising. Useful for tests
and examples that exercise multiple modalities against checkpoints with varying support.
skip_invalid_samples.title: Skip Invalid Samples

benchmark.title: Benchmark

warmup.description: Number of warmup generations before each sample.
warmup.title: Warmup

num_iterations.description: Number of benchmark generations to run after warmup.
num_iterations.title: Num Iterations

max_model_len.description:
Maximum total tokens per batch.  When set, samples are packed into
batches by token count.
max_model_len.title: Max Model Len

max_num_seqs.description:
Maximum number of sequences per batch.  When set, samples are packed into
batches by number of sequences.
max_num_seqs.title: Max Num Seqs

diffusion_cache.description:
Enable the diffusion-time inference cache.
Shared inference setup disables the cache by default. The inference CLI enables
it by default; pass ``--no-diffusion-cache`` to disable it. Caching is based on
SeaCache: Spectral-Evolution-Aware Cache for Accelerating Diffusion Models
(https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18993). Autoregressive and KV-cache generation
bypass the cache automatically.
diffusion_cache.title: Diffusion Cache

diffusion_cache_thresh.description:
Accumulated relative-L1 threshold (``diffusion_cache_thresh``), shared by the
conditional and unconditional pathways. Larger values allow more skipping at
the cost of lower fidelity. ``None`` uses the ``DiffusionCache.Config`` default
(0.25). Only takes effect when diffusion cache is enabled.
diffusion_cache_thresh.title: Diffusion Cache Thresh

diffusion_cache_residual_order.description:
Polynomial order for extrapolating the generation residual on a skipped step via
Newton divided differences: 0 = constant reuse, 1 = linear, 2 = quadratic.
``None`` uses the default (1).  Only used when diffusion cache is enabled.
diffusion_cache_residual_order.title: Diffusion Cache Residual Order

diffusion_cache_max_consecutive_cached.description:
Maximum consecutive residual reuses per CFG pathway before forcing a full
evaluation. ``0`` disables the limit and ``None`` uses the cache default (2).
Only used when diffusion cache is enabled.
diffusion_cache_max_consecutive_cached.title: Diffusion Cache Max Consecutive Cached
